macros.name: AddQuotes
macros.doc: \AddQuotes automatically surrounds code with single quotes.

macros.name: BuildCsSyntax
macros.doc: \BuildCsSyntax will be a permanent alias for the active escape character.

macros.name: CmdSyntaxVerb
macros.doc: \CmdSyntaxVerb will be a permanent alias for the active &.

macros.name: HardVerbBox
macros.doc: \HardVerbBox is a variant of \GenCmdBox with the meta-variable feature disabled (for the documentation of the present package).

macros.name: LQverb
macros.doc: \LQverb will be a “permanent alias” for the active left single quote.

macros.name: niceverbNoVerbList
macros.doc: \niceverbNoVerbList is the list of macros that will be executed instead of being typeset.

macros.name: nvAllRightQuotesSansSerif
macros.doc: \nvAllRightQuotesSansSerif (after \begin{document}!) forces the \textsf feature without testing for apostrophes.

macros.name: nvResetPages
macros.doc: \nvResetPages can be used to restore LaTeX’s \@resetactivechars.

macros.name: RQsansserif
macros.doc: \RQsansserif will be a permanent alias for the active single right quote.

macros.name: SetOffInlineCmdBoxInner
macros.doc: \SetOffInlineCmdBoxInner enables controlling the inner horizontal space to the box margin independently of \fboxsep.

macros.name: SetOffInlineCmdBoxOuter
macros.doc: \SetOffInlineCmdBoxOuter allows that the box hangs out into the margin horizontally.

macros.name: useNiceVerb
macros.doc: \useNiceVerb activates all the niceverb features (apart from “auto mode”).
